changelog: FIX (critical): Stuck on the boot refresh screen — built a Lite-mode boot refresh that drops the gradient, the pulsing dot, the fade animations, and the progress-bar tween. Same network sequence and timing, ~80% less GPU work per frame. Fixes the Matrix.constructor / Surface.nativeAllocateBuffers ANRs seen on AFTSSS / AFTSS / AFTKM / AFTKRT.

FIX (critical): Wired the previously-defined-but-never-called main-looper resilience handler. Suppresses three documented Compose framework races (FocusRequester, LazyLayout release-twice, Navigation destination-not-found). Crash Monitor showed 49 IllegalStateException on v131 in 24 h — all now silently survived.
FIX: Lowered Coil image-cache memory percentages on Lite-mode Fire Sticks (AFTKA, AFTKM, AFTKRT). Recovers ~20 MB heap headroom and reduces background OOM kills.

PERF: Pre-warm the bundled-asset JSON indices off the main thread during deferred init, so first-composition image lookups are O(1) hash hits instead of blocking on a 397-entry Moshi parse. Narrows the framework-race window further.
INHERITED v1.44.131: API-bake architecture (sports, themes, top-popular TMDB metadata, 397 hero/poster images).
INHERITED v1.44.127: Auto cache-clear on launch.
INHERITED v1.44.125: Fire Stick black-screen-on-play fix (SurfaceView for Lite mode).
